label: GOD_3 to GOD_4 by reference to a common maximum (inference)
rule: Existential elimination, uniqueness of a maximum and substitution
meaning: Assume a GOD_4 bearer exists, both the actual use of the selected community and GOD_4 select only maxima in the same sense and profile, and any two maxima are identical. Every GOD_3 bearer is then identical with the existing GOD_4 bearer and is GOD_4. Using the result to support GOD_4 existence through the same bridge would be circular.
